lines: At one time, the life of J.K. Rowling, the author of the Harry Potter books, was not easy.
She had no job and no money.
Then one day, on a train, she had a good idea for a new book.
She started writing the Harry Potter story that evening, and completed the first book in five years.
She sent it to twelve big publishers, but all of them weren’t interested in it.
Finally, one small publisher agreed to publish the book.
But they said, “You’ll never make much money in children’s books.”
The book was a great success!
Both children and adults loved it.
Now it is famous all over the world.
body.text: At one time, the life of J.K. Rowling, the author of the Harry Potter books, was not easy. She was a single mother. She had no job and no money. Then one day, on a train, she had a good idea for a new book. She started writing the Harry Potter story that evening, and completed the first book in five years. She sent it to twelve big publishers, but all of them weren’t interested in it. Finally, one small publisher agreed to publish the book. But they said, “You’ll never make much money in children’s books.” However, the publisher was wrong. The book was a great success! Both children and adults loved it. Now it is famous all over the world.
